adjudication.rationale: In `handleNewBooking.ts`, `evt.destinationCalendar` is set to `null` when neither `eventType.destinationCalendar` nor `organizerUser.destinationCalendar` exists (`destinationCalendar: ... : null,`). A few lines later, for COLLECTIVE team events, the code does `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars);`, which becomes a silent no-op when `evt.destinationCalendar` is `null`. Since `teamDestinationCalendars` is populated from `users.slice(1)` when `isTeamEventType && eventType.schedulingType === "COLLECTIVE" && user.destinationCalendar`, this creates a real path where member calendars are collected but never applied to `evt`, so downstream logic that depends on `event.destinationCalendar` being a non-empty array will not create events for those member calendars.
